summary: Five backcountry snowmobilers ran out of fuel near the Lost Creek Ranger Station, Routt County; group took shelter at the ranger station and was contacted by Classic Air; Moffat County SAR hauled fuel to their location early Sunday morning and all five riders were brought safely back to the trailhead where family were waiting
responding_agency: Moffat County Search and Rescue; Classic Air Medical
notes: Date approximate: Basin Now article archive-dated 2023-01-10 describes a "busy weekend" with the fuel haul early Sunday morning -> 2023-01-08; Moffat County SAR mutual-aid assist in Routt County
